findings.evidence: In `build_report` (`template/scripts/requirement_metrics.py`), `_children` returns `unknown("offline")` for `children_count` when there are no receipts, so `infos` is empty. `children_total` then calls `total([])`, which returns `derived(0)`. Because `children_count.status` is not measured or derived, it wraps that in `lower_bound`, which returns `partial(0, ..., "offline")`. As a result `executions`, `review_rounds`, `ci_runs` and the other totals show 0 with status partial. The spec says: "The report SHALL NOT substitute zero or an estimate for unknown evidence". Unknown would match the spec better when the child set itself is unknown.
findings.summary: When the report runs offline and no local receipts identify any child, headline totals come out as a partial 0 instead of unknown. The requirement-metrics spec says unknown evidence must not be replaced by zero.

findings.evidence: The spec (`requirement-metrics` "The report exposes the cost of mandatory independent review") says the report SHALL show "per round the reviewer launches, per-perspective ... wall time, findings by severity and dispositions". In `_review`, `round_details` holds no dispositions. `_dispositions(archive, versions, rounds)` builds a single section from the final `independent-review-dispositions.json`. It computes `material_findings` from `rounds[-1]` only. Dispositions from earlier published rounds are therefore not shown. `rejected` and `blocker` are counted only from the final record, so any earlier record is ignored.
findings.summary: The review-cost requirement asks for dispositions per round. The implementation reports one aggregate disposition block per child, and its `material_findings` counts only the last round.
